gen-luckiest-guy-gf-mukta-mahee: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy pours out thick, uniform letters with a mean line set high, while Mukta Mahee stays approachable beneath. Over many lines its chunky, tall lowercase keeps going without tiring.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-mukta-malar: Loud, bright, poured-ink lettering up top. Luckiest Guy does bold and bouncy best, with no thin spots between stems and joins, while Mukta Malar handles the quiet work with compressed ascenders and a neutral, approachable manner.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-mukta-vaani: Mukta Vaani reads contemporary and neutral, with a high-waisted lowercase that sits tidily on the line. Luckiest Guy, drawn with strokes as constant as bent wire, then adds the shout, and the body keeps pace without fuss.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-narnoor: Professional and neutral, Narnoor tucks short ascenders above big bowls beneath a Luckiest Guy heading whose joins never thin out. Cheerful shouting meets level-headed text.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display reads approachable, its big, tall middle zone making every word feel generous. And over a full page, Luckiest Guy stays the cheerful shout while the text just keeps talking.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-port-lligat-sans: Loud and round, then tightly packed. Luckiest Guy's bowls keep their walls uniform, and Port Lligat Sans answers with a minimal cap-to-lowercase step and open-sided bowls.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-ramabhadra: Ramabhadra reads clean and professional, helped along by a prominent x-height that fills each line nicely. But Luckiest Guy does the loud, poured-ink cheer, and the body font does the steady, tidy explaining.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-rambla: Clean is how Rambla looks, its small letters standing almost as tall as capitals under a cheerful Luckiest Guy heading. And if that heading shrank, its single flat line weight would lose its swagger.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-recursive: Recursive reads approachable and modern, with a tall mean line and a thickness that holds steady in every direction. Recursive also makes the loudest, most cheerful heading feel at home, which is this pair's strongest quality.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-roboto-condensed: That mean line set high gives Luckiest Guy its cheerful bark. Roboto Condensed answers with barely visible gaps inside each word and a line gliding like wire, which makes the pair feel tightly knit.
